No High or Medium Slither findings reported; only informational and optimization items exist. The contract lacks access controls, upgradeability, pausing, and uses direct balance arithmetic plus external transfers.

report.overall: TetherToken implements a deprecated upgrade path, pausable mechanics, blacklist, and optional fees via owner-controlled parameters. All 15 Slither Medium findings stem from non-standard ERC20 signatures (no bool returns, extra modifiers) declared in ERC20Basic/ERC20 and implemented in BasicToken/StandardToken/TetherToken. No High-severity issues reported; arithmetic uses SafeMath and access is owner-restricted.

When deprecated, calls transferByLegacy etc. on arbitrary upgradedAddress set by owner.

slither_triage.why: ERC20Basic.transfer and ERC20.approve/transferFrom declared without return values; TetherToken overrides add onlyPayloadSize, whenNotPaused and blacklist checks while preserving signatures.

The provided source contains a non-reentrant lock modifier, SafeMath, and explicit event emissions but no upgrade or pause mechanisms.

report.overall: UniswapV2Router02 is a stateless router with no owner, pausable logic or upgrade path; all state changes occur in immutable UniswapV2Pair contracts. The three High Slither findings map directly to the two fee-on-transfer swap paths that read balanceBefore before an external pair.swap and to the bare transferFrom in removeLiquidity. Six Medium findings are all ignored return values on sortTokens, getReserves and createPair calls that the surrounding code does not rely on for control flow.

Bare transferFrom in removeLiquidity at L328; TransferHelper.safe* used elsewhere.
Ignored returns from sortTokens, getReserves and createPair are never used for control flow or amount calculation.

report.overall: SwapRouter (contracts/SwapRouter.sol) is a stateless router that encodes paths, performs pool swaps via callbacks, and inherits Multicall, PeripheryPaymentsWithFee, SelfPermit and PeripheryValidation. The provided source contains no access-control modifiers, no upgrade logic, no events, and delegates all token movement to pay() and pool.swap(). Slither flags center on arbitrary transferFrom in the inherited pay() and the delegatecall loop inside Multicall.multicall.

checklist.note: No owner or role checks present; payer is always msg.sender or address(this) after first hop as shown in exactInput/exactOutputInternal.
Constructor only sets immutable factory and WETH9 via PeripheryImmutableState; no proxy or upgrade paths in source.
uniswapV3SwapCallback and exact*Internal call external pool.swap which re-enters the router; Multicall permits arbitrary re-entrant sequences.
No oracle or price feeds; only sqrtPriceLimitX96 passed directly to pool.swap.
Uses SafeCast.toInt256 and explicit amount0/amount1 delta checks; no unchecked math blocks visible in SwapRouter or Multicall.
getPool().swap, pay(), and delegatecall(data[i]) all perform external calls; pay() performs arbitrary transferFrom per Slither.
SelfPermit wraps ERC20Permit.permit with deadline and nonce; no additional signatures in SwapRouter.
No pause flag or emergency functions defined in any of the listed contracts.
SelfPermitIfNecessary and pay() rely on prior or on-the-fly approvals; arbitrary payer in pay() flagged by Slither.
No emit statements appear in SwapRouter.sol, Multicall.sol, Path.sol or SelfPermit.sol.

slither_triage.why: pay() intentionally accepts payer from SwapCallbackData to support multihop routing; caller is validated via CallbackValidation.verifyCallback before pay.
Multicall.multicall is explicitly intended to batch calls via delegatecall in a payable loop; documented risk accepted by periphery design.
Finding points to FullMath in @uniswap/v3-core which is not part of the supplied SwapRouter source.
pay() ignores return value of IWETH9.transfer and some ERC20.transferFrom calls; source does not show any require or safe wrapper around those transfers.
